verbatim_quotes.text: This was based on data from the HPTN 083 trial, where 22/2483 (0.9%) individuals received a false positive RNA test, resulting in four who delayed CAB-LA initiation, two who discontinued CAB-LA and one who had delayed oral CAB; none of these seven individuals had evidence of HIV.
In HPTN 083, 11 of 22 false-positive NAT results originated from an LMIC site.

This is based on data from HPTN 083 open-label extension [] where there was a sensitivity of 82.8% (65.5%–92.4%) and PPV of 54.6% (40.1–68.3) for detecting HIV if using RDT and laboratory-based immunoassay, compared with sensitivity of 100% (88.3–100) and PPV of 56.9% (43.3–69.5) when using NAT.
